page.overview:
What is Aucturn?

Aucturn (the Stranger), also called the Newborn, is a Great Old One created by Paizo Inc for the Pathfinder role-playing game in 2007. It is in Paizo Inc's Starfinder roleplaying game that Aucturn was fully developed. In the Second Edition of Starfinder, Aucturn "hatches", fully developing into an Outer God with a profound grudge against Nyarlathotep for his attempted enslavement of it.

Aucturn is a newly born or created Great Old One. It is a living planet with an inhospitable geography, one that is mutable. Landmasses consist of chalky stone or rubber soil from which stunted, mutated vegetation grows. Unseen leviathans swim through the black sludge of its oceans. The atmosphere consists of poisonous gases, which vary depending on the place, from clinging soupy neurotoxin in one area to a thin hallucinogenic mist at another. From its yellow sky, acidic rain pours on the land. Its geography is in a state of flux, morphing and twisting as the planet heaves and contracts. Rivers are drained and mountain ranges of flesh-like hummocks are created. Usually these changes happen over months or years, but sometimes they occur within moments.

Most of the planet's lifeforms are both vicious and monstrous, which include Shoggoths and Gugs. The most common lifeform are the Orocorans, semi-intelligent predators considered by most to be nuisances, but which pose a threat when gathering into large swarms. On the planet, there is an ongoing feud between the followers of the Outer Gods who dominate the world and the scattered cells of the Dominion of the Black. It is a lawless place, where evil runs rampant. Among the world's residents, no topic of study is forbidden and no act is taboo. Great factories produce illegal drugs outside of the reach of the law, revolutionaries plot against the governments of their homeworlds, slavery is common, and scholars research the forbidden arts so they can warp reality. The unofficial leader of Aucturn is the mysterious Carsai the King, who is suspected of being an avatar of Nyarlathotep.

In the leadup to Starfinder Second Edition, it is revealed that Nyarlathotep was actually attempting to corrupt Aucturn and enslave it to his will, rather than assist in its midwifing as it fully developed in its planet-shaped egg. However, Shelyn, the goddess of love, and her brother, Zon-Kuthon the god of despair, discovered this and set aside their feud to stop him, with Zon-Kuthon sacrificing his life to save his sister. This disrupted Nyarlathotep's ritual to take command of Aucturn's gestation, and its hatching proceeded normally, destroying its planet-form (and leaving behind a massive asteroid belt) but allowing itself to become the Newborn, the Outer God of cosmic horrors, paradigm shifts, and renewal while banishing Carsai from the Pact Worlds. In the main setting of 2E, it is still figuring out what it wishes to be, and Nyarlathotep's actions have alienated it from the other Outer Gods, leading it to be a neutral entity that may help or hinder mortals as they beseech it or to its whim. Its heralds are the Midwives, who were a cult that assisted in its gestation and now serve as ambassadors of its form of rebirth.
